entries.0e2584611c4314ed: It is a publisher specializing in education, headquartered in Hashima, Gifu Prefecture. The group consists of the company, 2 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 non-consolidated subsidiaries, and its headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 247 employees. Its shares are listed on the Main Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
entries.0ece2592230f7da6: It manufactures and sells publications such as elementary school educational books, general trade books and junior high school educational books, and teaching aids such as sewing sets and home economics fabric materials. It is also advancing development of teaching materials that combine digital with the strengths of paper-based materials.
entries.0ed22612d9ffe59f: It is a publisher specializing in education, headquartered in Hashima, Gifu Prefecture.
entries.2fcc0886480d83ea: Under the corporate philosophy 'Let us aim to be a company that creates education and culture and contributes to society through developing people for the 21st century', the company states that it maintains a frontline-first stance. Its management strategy states that it focuses on 6 priorities: developing new types of teaching materials; enhancing product planning for teaching aids and expanding sales channels; developing and selling hybrid teaching materials that combine paper and digital, and software that reduces teachers' workload; securing rights to highly original teaching materials and teaching aids; streamlining consolidated management; and creating teaching materials that are easy for everyone to use. It also aims to transform from a teaching materials company into a comprehensive educational services company.
entries.3d9e3c448c59a479: Its core publications, such as tests and drills, must conform to the Courses of Study and textbooks set by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, and it continues editing to revise content in line with periodic textbook revisions. The elementary school textbook revision was implemented in fiscal 2024, and the company explains that whether it can provide teaching materials that respond to the revision affects sales.
entries.44ad984486f9b0e2: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,139 million. Revenue from external customers by segment was ¥8,385 million for publishing and ¥3,753 million for teaching aids.
